$comment: The first theme token map: a Web UI theme property and the token of the new app it sets. A Layer 0 theme's `tokens` are CSS custom properties applied to <html> (libs/shared/app-config/src/lib/bootstrap-config.ts), and the app's styles read Material's system tokens, so each target is one of those colour roles. Only clear one-to-one roles are mapped. Every other property is reported with the reason that matches its name, nearest prefix first: a migration keeps no custom CSS (parity decision 5), so what has no token does not migrate.

source.how: The 105 properties of the sample's theme, against the --mat-sys-* tokens the app's stylesheets read.

reported.--nuxeo-app-font: Fonts come from the Satori theme, not from a token
reported.--nuxeo-: No token of the app matches this Web UI property yet
reported.--paper-: It styles a Polymer paper element, and the app has none
reported.--iron-: It styles a Polymer iron element, and the app has none
reported.--: A Polymer palette variable; the brand comes from Web UI's own properties
